requirements.evidence: Notifier matches the contract: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:10 `send(string $title, string $message, array $context = []): void`; no-op on null/empty URL (:14-16); `Http::timeout(3)->post($url, ['content' => $text])` (:22); key=value lines joined with \n (:42-54); `mb_substr($text, 0, 1800)` (:19); case-insensitive key redaction after stripping -/_ (:82-91), Bearer regex (:73), recursive arrays then json_encode (:63-70, :45-46); non-2xx logged at error with status only (:24-26); Throwable caught and URL scrubbed from the message (:27-35). Config: audit channel config/logging.php:76-82 (daily, logs/audit.log, level info, days 90); stack default `daily` (:57); services.discord.webhook_url (config/services.php:31-33); LOG_STACK=daily in .env.example and phpunit.xml; no discord channel added. Gaps: the `daily` channel itself (days 14 via LOG_DAILY_DAYS) is not touched in the diff, so it relies on the existing config, which isn't shown. buildText runs outside the try (:18), so a context value that can't be cast to string (e.g. stdClass) throws, which breaks the 'never throw' requirement.

conventions.evidence: Test-first artifacts are present (tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php), docs/ops/logging.md was added, and CHANGELOG.md has an [Unreleased] entry, in line with 'Keep docs in sync'. .env.example has the new keys. The style is plain Laravel. Deviation: the new public `send()` has no PHPDoc, although conventions ask for 'PHPDoc on public methods you touched'.

security.evidence: Redaction covers sensitive keys including nested ones (:57-60, :63-70) and Bearer strings (:73). The webhook URL is never put in log context: only `status` (:25), or the exception message after `str_replace((string) $url, '[redacted]', ...)` (:28). A small residual risk: only the exact URL string is scrubbed, so a URL-encoded or partial form of the URL in an exception message would leak. That's limited impact.

tests.evidence: Tests cover the no-op for null and empty URL, the content format and URL, truncation to exactly 1800, key/Bearer/nested redaction, non-2xx and transport-exception logging, and never-throw (tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:12-104). But the two tests named '...without url' only assert `Log::shouldHaveReceived('error')->once()` (:81, :92) and never check that the URL is absent from the message or context, so the scrubbing requirement is untested. Nothing tests the logging config contract (audit channel driver/path/days/level, `daily` in stack.channels, no discord channel, `Log::channel('audit')->info(...)` works). The never-throw test is `expect(true)->toBeTrue()` and doesn't cover non-stringable context.

simplicity.evidence: A single small class built on Laravel's Http and Log facades. Redaction is one recursive helper plus a key check (:57-91). There are no extra abstractions or bindings, and the config changes are minimal.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and clearly named (buildText, redactValue, isSensitiveKey). The nested try/catch around Log::error (:30-34) is defensive but commented. The if/else for rendering (:45-49) could be a ternary, but it is clear. There's no debug output or dead code.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: notifier, services config, logging config, .env.example, phpunit.xml, docs/ops/logging.md, CHANGELOG, test. Adding `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` as an empty value in phpunit.xml (:236) is a reasonable safety pin. The notifier is not wired into any job or handler, which the task puts out of scope.

issues.explanation: The tests named 'logs error ... without url' never assert that the webhook URL is absent from the logged message or context, so the URL-scrubbing requirement is untested.

Nothing tests the logging configuration contract (audit channel driver/path/days/level, `daily` in stack channels, no `discord` channel, audit writes accepted), although conventions require every change to ship with tests.
buildText runs outside the try block and casts values with `(string)`, so a non-stringable context value (e.g. stdClass) throws an Error into the caller, which violates the 'never throw' requirement.
The diff doesn't touch the `daily` channel, so the 14-day retention via `LOG_DAILY_DAYS` depends on existing config that isn't shown and can't be confirmed.
The new public `send()` method has no PHPDoc describing its soft-fail and redaction behavior, as the project conventions ask.
Only the exact URL string is scrubbed, so an encoded or partial copy of the webhook token in an exception message would still be logged.

review.summary: The change adds a compact, correct DiscordOpsAlert notifier with config-driven no-op, 1800-character multibyte truncation, recursive key/Bearer redaction and soft-fail logging that keeps the URL out. It also adds the audit channel, switches the stack default to daily, and documents the three lanes. The implementation meets nearly every requirement and stays in scope. I'd approve with nits: the tests don't verify that the URL stays out of the logs or cover the logging config, and a non-stringable context value can still throw.
